purpose: Curated retrieval, curriculum and evaluation sources for PIE agents with provenance, rights and currentness controls.

rights_rules.OFFICIAL_PUBLIC_REFERENCE: Reference/retrieve only unless the specific licence or law permits storage/reuse.
rights_rules.OPEN_GUIDANCE: Admit text only when the licence permits the intended storage/reuse; otherwise use retrieval and citations.
rights_rules.LICENSED_METADATA_ONLY: Store metadata and control mapping only; full text requires a lawful ANK licence/permission.
rights_rules.WITHDRAWN_REFERENCE_ONLY: May be retained as historical/currentness evidence but never promoted as current authority.
rights_rules.HISTORICAL_REFERENCE_ONLY: May train chronology/currentness recognition but not current-law/current-policy claims.
